Priyom —

Appreciate the MAP. Quick answers from our side: 

- Evaluation criteria: p95 latency <= 250ms for the chat flow (synchronous), embeddings batch throughput >= 1000 reqs/min for our nightly jobs. Quality: no more than a 5% drop in our current intent-classification F1 on the validation set.
- Data residency: for PHI flows we must keep data in US regions only and prefer us-west for production due to our regional backup policy. PoC can run in us-east.
- Procurement timeline: procurement is asking for final SOW and an initial quote by June 24 to hit our July 1 kickoff. I’m looping in procurement and Marcus who will take point on budget questions.

Also: security wants the SOC2 scope doc and an answer on whether KMS keys can be customer-managed in Dedicated.

Thanks —
Elena
Head of Product, Altius Health

Subject: Re: MAP gating - proposed staging and gating rules

Putting together the technical gating framework for the MAP — marking up the choices so the commercial team has a clear decision tree to include in the SOW. High-level proposal: 

1) PoC (evaluation) — Hosted API in us-east
   - Run 2-week evaluation window with fixed dataset and 3 stress patterns: low-latency chat, bulk embeddings, and peak concurrency (50 concurrent users).
   - Acceptance: p95 latency <= 250ms for chat; embedding throughput >= 1k/min; no model regression >5% on F1.

2) Staging — Dedicated pool in us-east (if cost permits) or us-west if customer insists on prod geo parity
   - Use prefix caching + KV cache enabled. Performance smoke tests must pass under 4x expected traffic.
   - Security: Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS; customer to provide KMS ARN before provisioning.

3) Production — Either Dedicated in us-west (preferred) or Private (on-prem) as a contractual option only if data residency or audit constraints require full air gap.
   - SLOs: 99.95% uptime; fallbacks to lower-cost hosted variant if Dedicated pool lacks capacity (with explicit throttling rules).

Costs: I’ll export a delta table (hosted vs dedicated vs private) and attach region-costs.csv. Marissa — please review commercial framing for a 6/30 close target; procurement asked 6/24 for SOW/quote.

— Karthik
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
